fields.statement: QA at e288b6b36 with a scratch build: daemon --once picked myteam-flow by rule ready.feature; the run of docs/examples/byo/workflow.toml passed services, work, gate (lint fail handed back to work, then pass), signoff, push, wait-ci, merge, close-out; succeeded, intervention_count 0; docker compose up then down; cleanup stop-services pass. TestScripts/byo-workflow-daemon and TestDocsExample pass.

QA at e288b6b36 with a scratch build: myteam-flow's push (ship open-pr) passed with no review journaled; the same workflow with a checks step added refused push with 'has no review journaled: its workflow declares a review'; ship open-pr outside a run refused. TestShipOpenPR|TestReviewJournaled|TestReviewDeclared, internal/workflow, run-ship-change and ship-open-pr scripts pass.

QA at e288b6b36 with a scratch build: close-out failing once; daemon --once queued a --retry continuation (failed retry 1 of 1), the next poll resumed it, the resume retried only close-out (visit 2, retried) and the run succeeded with intervention_count 0. With close-out always failing, the retry failed and the next poll left it to the inbox with no second retry. TestScripts/byo-workflow-retry passes.

QA at e288b6b36 with a scratch build: after a daemon poll at load 3.5, the myteam-flow run's work step was spawn-held (inbox shows it with the load-high detail, no agent started); a poll at load 1 released it and the run succeeded. Outside-message intervention (1) and own-message (0) shown by the passing byo-workflow-hold-intervention script.

QA at e288b6b36: TestStallLimit|TestWatchdog|TestRunaway pass incl. TestWatchdogStalledBYO and TestWatchdogRunawayBYO; scratch-built rhiza docs output is identical to docs/reference, commandLimit described as covering command and gate steps.
